criteria.name: Info and relationships
criteria.evidence: source: renders a div unless as sets another element
criteria.note: Whether a page uses the right element (list, section, nav) is for a person to judge.

criteria.name: Contrast (minimum)
criteria.evidence: source: colours come from the caller

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: screenshots and scroll width at 1280, 390 and 320: no horizontal scroll for normal text; in LongContent an unbroken 80 character string runs past 390 (602px)
criteria.note: Box sets no overflow-wrap; long unbroken strings (links, ids) need one from the caller.

criteria.name: Text spacing
criteria.evidence: text spacing override (line height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, paragraph 2em) on Default and LongContent: no clipped text
